extracted.intended_audience: student broadcast and digital journalists (undergraduate and high school students) and faculty advisers submitting to the Student Edward R. Murrow Awards
extracted.subtask_description: Rules and judging criteria for submitting student broadcast and digital journalism work to the RTDNA Student Edward R. Murrow Awards, including eligibility, category-specific formatting/length rules, submission format, fees, and the dimensions on which entries will be judged.

rubrics_metrics.name: Eligibility — enrollment and institution identification
rubrics_metrics.description: The competition is open to anyone enrolled as a full-time undergraduate or high school student. The name of the high school, college or university must be clearly referenced in the entry materials.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Entries may be submitted by advisers on behalf of students, but entries should be made in the name of an individual student or team of students, not in the name of a faculty member.

rubrics_metrics.name: Production timeframe
rubrics_metrics.description: All entries must have been produced in the year prior.

rubrics_metrics.name: Authorship and employment restriction
rubrics_metrics.description: The work must be that of the student(s) and must have been produced while the entrant(s) was/were enrolled as an undergraduate or high school student and not employed in a professional news gathering capacity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Classroom exercise exclusion
rubrics_metrics.description: Work produced solely as a classroom exercise will not be eligible.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A classroom exercise is defined as an assignment for fulfillment of a course requirement unless it was also published, broadcast, or made available to the public on a digital platform.

rubrics_metrics.name: One award per category (competition structure)
rubrics_metrics.description: One Student Murrow Award will be awarded to an individual or team of students in each of eight categories.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Entries are judged on the national level and winners are recognized at the RTDNA Edward R. Murrow Awards Gala.

rubrics_metrics.name: Entries in audio/video categories: submission format
rubrics_metrics.description: Entries in the audio and video categories must be submitted in the form of a URL to the online awards site.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Entries will be judged based on the original work samples and not on the way the entry is produced.

rubrics_metrics.name: Digital entries: URL requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: Entries in the digital category must be functioning, cached or active URLs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submit a functioning, cached or active URL linking to a single report.

rubrics_metrics.name: Language-translations requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: Entries not originally produced or broadcast in English should include English subtitles or a written English translation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Voice-over/narration rule
rubrics_metrics.description: Voice-overs or narratives are permitted only if they were part of the original piece(s).

rubrics_metrics.name: Short description requested
rubrics_metrics.description: A short description of the entry is requested.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Many categories explicitly request a short description alongside the submitted work.

rubrics_metrics.name: Judging basis — original work samples
rubrics_metrics.description: Judging will be based on the original work samples and not on the way the entry is produced.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fees and payment requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: Each entry must be accompanied by the correct entry fee.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: RTDNA Members: $20 per Entry; Non-Members: $40 per Entry. RTDNA accepts Visa, MasterCard and American Express. For totals in excess of $1,500, payment may be made by check. No refunds will be issued.

rubrics_metrics.name: Judges' finality and discretion
rubrics_metrics.description: At the discretion of the judges, awards may not be granted in some categories. Decisions of the judges are final.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cross-entry to professional Murrow competition
rubrics_metrics.description: Student Edward R. Murrow entries may also be entered into the professional Edward R. Murrow competition, so long as they meet the applicable criteria in the category or categories in which they are entered.

rubrics_metrics.name: Removal of commercial breaks and editing rules (general)
rubrics_metrics.description: All commercial breaks must be removed from entries.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Some categories allow editing (podcasts, features, hard news); newscast categories require removal of commercial breaks but no other editing is allowed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Excellence in Podcasts — definition and entry limits
rubrics_metrics.description: Podcasts are defined as digital audio files made available on the internet, typically available as a series. Entry may feature a single episode or an edited overview of a series that does not exceed 30 minutes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Entry must demonstrate original and outstanding journalistic enterprise on an important issue. Entry may be edited, and all commercial breaks must be removed. Entrants should also provide an active link to the full podcast series.

rubrics_metrics.name: Excellence in Audio Feature Reporting
rubrics_metrics.description: Submit a single report covering a human-interest or profile subject that is not breaking news or investigative in nature.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Entry may not be entered in the Reporting: Hard News category. A short description of the entry is requested. Entry may be edited. Entry must not exceed 30 minutes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Excellence in Audio Hard News
rubrics_metrics.description: Entries should consist of one piece, series, or package demonstrating exceptional news coverage and journalistic skill.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Humorous or soft-topic stories do not belong in this category. Entry may not be entered in the Feature Reporting category. Entry may be edited. Entry must not exceed 30 minutes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Excellence in Audio Newscast
rubrics_metrics.description: Newscast entries should consist of a complete newscast up to 30 minutes in length.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If the newscast is longer than 30 minutes, submit only the first 30 minutes. Any commercial breaks must be removed from the entry but no other editing is allowed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Excellence in Video Feature Reporting
rubrics_metrics.description: Submit a single report covering a human-interest or profile subject that is not breaking news or investigative in nature.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Entry may not be entered in the Reporting: Hard News category. A short description of the entry is requested. Entry may be edited. Entry must not exceed 30 minutes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Excellence in Video Hard News
rubrics_metrics.description: Entries should consist of one piece, series, or package demonstrating exceptional news coverage and journalistic skill.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Humorous or soft-topic stories do not belong in this category. Entry may not be entered in the Feature Reporting category. Entry may be edited. Entry must not exceed 30 minutes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Excellence in Video Newscast
rubrics_metrics.description: Newscast entries should consist of a complete newscast up to 30 minutes in length.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If the newscast is longer than 30 minutes, submit only the first 30 minutes. Any commercial breaks must be removed from the entry but no other editing is allowed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Excellence in Digital Reporting
rubrics_metrics.description: Submit a functioning, cached or active URL linking to a single report.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A short description of the entry is requested. If the entry includes audio or video content, total run time may not exceed 30 minutes. Interactivity and use of multimedia tools will be considered for digital entries.

rubrics_metrics.name: Judging dimension — depth and scope of journalistic ability
rubrics_metrics.description: The depth and scope of the student’s/students’ journalistic ability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Judging dimension — adherence to RTDNA Code of Ethics
rubrics_metrics.description: Adherence to the RTDNA Code of Ethics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Judging dimension — interactivity and use of multimedia tools (digital)
rubrics_metrics.description: Interactivity and use of multimedia tools (digital entries).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This dimension applies especially to digital reporting entries.

rubrics_metrics.name: Judging dimension — accuracy and completeness
rubrics_metrics.description: Accuracy and completeness.

rubrics_metrics.name: Judging dimension — creativity
rubrics_metrics.description: Creativity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Judging dimension — execution
rubrics_metrics.description: Execution.
